Admins can now change a user's role from a select in each row of the users table. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/users/api/update-user-role.ts` sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`. A zod schema limits the role to `ADMIN` or `USER`.
- **List refresh:** after a successful change, the hook invalidates the `['users']` query, so the table shows the new role.
- **Success message:** the "User Role Updated" notification is raised inside the mutation hook in `api/`, as `features/CLAUDE.md` requires. It uses `useNotifications.getState()`, the same way `lib/api-client.ts` does. The older components like `delete-user.tsx` still raise theirs in the component, so I didn't copy that pattern.
- **UI:** the new `components/update-user-role.tsx` renders the select. `users-list.tsx` now uses it in the Role column. The select is disabled while the request is in flight.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH /users/:userId/role` handler to `testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`. It requires an admin and is limited to the admin's own team.

I used a plain `<select>` in the row. The shared `Select` in `components/ui/form/select.tsx` is built around react-hook-form's `registration`, which doesn't fit an inline control.

Your notes rule says to update the `notes/` folder after code changes. I didn't, because there is no `notes/` folder in this project.
